events.title: Development - September 2026
events.summary: Hello!I've been working pretty hard on the game throughout September and coming into October, at the time of writing. Much has been done.The thing that has been taking up most of my time is fully fledged Controller support. In the previous versions, I was using a cursor that was controlled by the thumbsticks when using a Controller. This was absolutely awful I'll admit and I was never happy with it, but I HAD to include something for the sake of the demo. The Controller cursor was a band-aid fix

events.title: Development - New Logo & Art Graphics
events.summary: Hello!All new logo and branded store page and library art assets are here!Things look much nicer now! :DThank you to everyone for playing, following and reading the post!-Connor

events.title: Development - July/August 2026
events.summary: Hello!July was a needed break. I took some time away from the game to focus on health, go on some adventures, and gather new ideas and inspiration. I know it's mid August now but... that's what took most of my time in July. As for August, here!The latest new location I've been showing off so far is essentially finished, just some final bits to complete and gaps to fill in. events.title: Development - June 2026
events.summary: Hello!For June I've continued to work on the new location and content, while also getting some new Ai tweaks implemented. Some issues with Ai de-aggrovating and weird behavious at the edge of leash zones are very apparent in the current build, so I've been trying to fix these. I want the Ai to behave more technically predictable, and I've decided to simplify the enemy investigate and de-aggro behaviours to hopefully put more focus on the head-to-head combat. events.title: Development - May 2026
events.summary: Hello!Following the launch of the Demo, things have been pretty quiet on my part.
